defense_news.title: Dutch firm Optics11 in talks with navies on secretive underwater listening tech

defense_news.title: Firm bets on converted fishing trawlers to tackle Russian submarines in the Arctic
defense_news.summary: The company’s Arctic Hunter idea involves an industry-standard 56-meter trawler design whose fish-processing innards are ripped out and replaced with autonomy features.
